article.story: ALBANY, N.Y. -- — Anquan Hill scored 22 points and Nyle Ralph-Beyer added 21 to help Sacred Heart beat Siena 86-80 on Wednesday night to snap a six-game skid. Hill had five rebounds and Ralph-Beyer grabbed six. Mekhi Conner had 15 points and shot 5 for 8 from beyond the arc. Gavin Doty led the way for the Saints (11-7, 4-3) with 20 points and 12 rebounds. Francis Folefac added 18 points for Siena. Justice Shoats had 14 points and 11 assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
